# simbus

> Industrial field-device simulator: one process, one YAML, Modbus TCP (and TLS on 802), OPC UA on 4840, BACnet/IP on 47808, plus HTTP control.

This file is a **documentation map** for agents (same role as `/llms.txt` on a docs site). For how to **change this codebase**, read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Branch model and PR target (`develop`): [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). For **authoring a device YAML**, use the project skill [simbus-device](.agents/skills/simbus-device/SKILL.md) (`npx skills add obsidia-systems/simbus@simbus-device`).

Human front door: [README.md](README.md). Contracts live in `docs/` and win over Rust types when they disagree.

## Contracts

- [docs/spec.md](docs/spec.md): Device YAML language (boot contract; language 2 current, 1 still loads). Start here for new fields or protocols.
- [docs/runtime.md](docs/runtime.md): Binary, boot, CLI/env, signals, Docker, time scale, drain.
- [docs/modbus.md](docs/modbus.md): Field plane — Modbus TCP PDU (V1.1b3 / V1.0b) and TLS wrap (IANA `mbaps` 802).
- [docs/opcua.md](docs/opcua.md): Field plane — OPC UA (IANA 4840), YAML map as variables. None + Anonymous.
- [docs/bacnet.md](docs/bacnet.md): Field plane — BACnet/IP (IANA 47808), `export` rows as AI/AV/BI/BV objects. Who-Is, ReadProperty, WriteProperty.
- [docs/control.md](docs/control.md): Session HTTP (not the field protocol). OpenAPI at `GET /docs` on a running process.
- [docs/simulation.md](docs/simulation.md): Tick, `state.base`, behaviors, faults, encode.
- [docs/scenarios.md](docs/scenarios.md): How to run scenarios bundled in the device YAML (and session install).
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): Process shape, crates, repo layout.
- [docs/debt.md](docs/debt.md): Specified as not this version (extra protocols).
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): Diátaxis index.

## Device maps

Where files go (builtin vs community): [docs/spec.md](docs/spec.md) (maps table).
Every shipped map is language 2, and each product template follows the point
set its industry publishes (UPS on RFC 1628, power meter on the Eastron SDM630
map, PDU on Raritan/ServerTech, CRAC on Liebert iCOM, leak on locating panels).
- [devices/builtin/](devices/builtin/): `default.yaml` plus product-shaped templates (T&H, UPS, PDU, CRAC, power meter, leak, door).
- [devices/community/](devices/community/): Contributor maps (example: Papouch TH2E).

Validate any map with `simbus check <file>` (or `cargo run -p simbus -- check <file>`).

## Optional

- [index.html](index.html): Marketing landing, not a contract.

- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release notes (`## [Unreleased]` during development). How to cut a tag, bump versions, and publish: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) § Release.
